summary: Nova Minerals Ltd filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing that schemes of arrangement approved by the Supreme Court of New South Wales have become effective, effecting a corporate re-domestication. Under the schemes, Nova Minerals Corp (US Holdco) will acquire all issued ordinary shares and Nasdaq-listed warrants, making US Holdco the new parent entity. No per-share price or premium is stated. Trading suspension on ASX effective June 3, 2026. This is a cross-border holding-company migration (redomicile), not a traditional acquisition or going-private. Watch for Nasdaq listing of US Holdco securities.
